notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
48 literal collection names were found in queries or index definitions. A collection name in code does not prove that the collection exists in production.
Payments, refunds and shipments are embedded in orders. Wishlist is embedded in users. Categories are matched by catalog fields; no category foreign key is declared.
No Mongoose schemas were found; data models are TypeScript types plus runtime route validation.
